testcase.name: Scenario: Right-click a solid face while the panel selector is open: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:423:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Right-click a solid face while the panel selector is open ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with a visible solid in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full Tools ribbon and its panel selector are open ✔ When the user right-clicks a visible solid face outside the selector ✔ Then the panel selector closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon and part remain visible ✔ And no face context menu is visible in the captured state ✔ And a small face-selection control appears near the pointer
